1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Bc5 3.c3 Nf6 4.d4 exd4 5.e.strategy: Takes the knight rather than saving the bishop, so a piece trade follows. The pawn on f6 eyes g7 and cramps Black's kingside, and White hopes to turn the loose bishop on c5 into a target for an attack.

Takes the bishop with the pawn, so each side has lost a minor piece. Black has pawns on c4 and d4 and an active bishop on c5, but the pawn on f6 and the loose bishop are targets, so White's queen has real attacking chances.
